name: Agents
description: One list of a repository's agents (.devcontainer/agents.yml, or the repo-relative path in AGENTS_FILE: name, CLI, folder, args, kind, lifecycle, identity, lease, default), two kinds and one verb for every agent CLI: task agents -- <name> makes a resident agent run in the background and attaches to it, or opens a new session of an on-demand agent (--resume, --new); a stateful agent runs as exactly one live copy, guarded by an exclusive lease (a second start joins a resident or is refused for an on-demand agent; agents:leases, agents:release); agents:up starts every resident at container start (its postStartCommand, never fatal), agents:list, agents:stop, agents:logs, agents:check. Each CLI Feature supplies an adapter (agent-adapter-<cli> on PATH; the claude-code Feature ships agent-adapter-claude); an agent's session name (the label its CLI shows) is a template, default its handle, handed to the adapter in AGENT_SESSION_NAME; a verb an adapter does not support falls back and says so. Installs a bash script and the Feature Taskfile; nothing downloaded.

sessionName.description: The template of the session name the CLI shows for each agent (what Claude Code's remote view lists), for every agent without a session-name key of its own in the agent list. {handle} (the agent's name), {repo} (the repository folder's name) and {machine} (the workstation's name, DCF_HOST_MACHINE; the word container when it is unset) with free text around them, for example "{machine} {handle}". Letters, digits, space and . _ : @ / ( ) - only; at most 60 characters rendered; refused, never cut. The default shows the handle, as before 2.1. AGENTS_SESSION_NAME in .env or the environment overrides it.

installTaskfile.description: Also install this Feature's Taskfile into /usr/local/share/go-task/includes.d so its tasks appear under the <id>: namespace of a root Taskfile that includes /usr/local/share/go-task/features.yml (see the go-task Feature).
